svg.title: The best published energies by system size, one panel per method family
svg.desc: tensor network: 84 energies; transformer / ViT: 24 energies; CNN / ResNet: 24 energies; RNN: 52 energies; RBM: 60 energies; mean field: 12 energies; backflow / Pfaffian: 51 energies; other NQS: 14 energies; classic VMC: 46 energies; AFQMC / GFMC: 5 energies; VQE / circuit: 45 energies
svg.text: The best energies by system size, one panel per method family
Each panel colours one family's energies over all the others in grey and joins the family's best energy at each size. A method
that only ever ran at one size is a lone mark.
Each method name belongs to one family (scripts/method_names.mjs); 'other' holds exact methods and names no family covers. Filled marks can
hold a record, hollow ones cannot. Axes, the exact line included, as in the figure above: a better energy is lower. 4 rows lie below the exact
energy by more than twice the error bar and are not drawn.
